title: [review] project-LICHEN-6mij: CONFIG_COAP_SERVER_MESSAGE_SIZE in shared OSCORE respond function
description:
lichen_coap_oscore_respond() moved from static functions in CoAP-server-compiled files to coap_oscore.c (compiled under LICHEN_OSCORE). It uses CONFIG_COAP_SERVER_MESSAGE_SIZE as a stack buffer size. LICHEN_OSCORE Kconfig does not depend on COAP_SERVER, so this symbol may be undefined (0) when OSCORE is used without CoAP server (e.g., client-only mode).

Affected file: lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore/coap_oscore.c:223

Fixes:
(a) Guard the function with #ifdef CONFIG_COAP_SERVER, or
(b) Replace with CONFIG_LICHEN_OSCORE_PLAINTEXT_MAX, or
(c) Add 'depends on COAP_SERVER' to LICHEN_OSCORE Kconfig (trade-off: forces CoAP server for any OSCORE use)
